why_plausible: a ten-week window is as defensible as twelve; the contract does not fix it
the dashboard has always reported on the whole network, so the monitoring population is the network
disproved_by: MRM-04 section 4.1 requires a population the model's own use has not influenced

why_plausible: reading the excluded clinics as the ones to exclude from the evaluation
disproved_by: those are exactly the clinics whose outcomes the programme did not touch

why_plausible: using the rebuilt feature store, which is what the monitoring pipeline already computes
disproved_by: MRM-04 section 4.2 requires the scores the model produced in service

why_plausible: confusing the candidate's batch rescore with the incumbent's served scores
disproved_by: model_scores carries a model_version; the registry says which is the incumbent

why_plausible: using the window the feature store now configures rather than the one the model was fitted on
disproved_by: the registry records the window the model's coefficients were estimated on

why_plausible: counting the patient's whole recent history rather than what was known at booking
disproved_by: a count that includes events after the booking date could not have been available to the scorer

why_plausible: auditing the one column the analyst thought of
disproved_by: the join that failed supplies several columns; the event log and the record disagree on all of them

why_plausible: comparing candidates first, which is the order a vendor proposal invites
disproved_by: MRM-04 section 4.4 states feed integrity first and forbids retraining around a defective feed

why_plausible: using the absolute floor and missing the clause relative to the validation figure
disproved_by: section 4.3 imposes both conditions and the floor is the lower of the two

why_plausible: applying the standard's test to the number the dashboard reports
disproved_by: the dashboard figure is computed on the intervened population, which section 4.1 excludes

why_plausible: comparing the arms over the whole book rather than inside the band the programme acts on
disproved_by: no patient outside the called band was ever called, so including them dilutes the effect

why_plausible: the vendor's account: drift explains the gap
disproved_by: the same model on an untouched population has not lost discrimination

why_plausible: hedging: name every cause so the right one is covered
disproved_by: each term is graded against its own value and the sum constraint prevents inflating them all

why_plausible: declaring the right population but computing the headline figure on the whole extract
disproved_by: the figure must be the one the shipped scores give on the population declared
